cases.title: Four single-message Fable 5.2 animation prompts (logo / promo / cinematic / 3D)
cases.author: Halil Sekeroglu
cases.prompt: In a single HTML file, make a cinematic scene that plays by itself: [scene, e.g. a lighthouse on a rock on a stormy night]. [What moves: e.g. the beam turns, rain falls, waves hit the rocks, lightning flashes far away.] The camera pushes in very slowly. Colour: [e.g. cold blue night, warm yellow light]. Use Canvas or WebGL, no external files. Full screen, fit a vertical screen, seamless 12-second loop.

cases.title: Isometric day/night city HTML loop — Claude Opus 5.5
cases.author: James Greene (model comparison archive)
cases.prompt: Build one self-contained HTML file: inline CSS and JavaScript only, no libraries, no external files, no network requests. Show an animated isometric city block that goes from day to night and back in a 12-second loop: the sky changes colour, windows light up at dusk, cars with headlights drive along the streets, and a small clock in one corner shows the time of day. It starts on its own when the page loads, needs no input, and fills the browser window at any size.
cases.pipeline: Self-contained HTML/CSS/JS animation · recorded also as MP4 on same page
cases.verify: Public HTML artifact + shared brief published · not our re-run
cases.license_notes: 比较站归档；本仓仅出处链接
